lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in roughly parallel horizontal rows across the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the circular spot centroids to form a grid-like lattice across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal ridges are visible on the upper lateral flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and shadowing on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of multiple remoras (Echeneidae) is visible swimming in the ventral water column beneath the pectoral fin.
